citation: History of Berrien and Van Buren Counties, Michigan (1880), Paw Paw Township, John K. Pugsley migration narrative.
note: Says John K. Pugsley left near Utica, New York in June 1835, traveled to Chicago, prospected there, then returned to Paw Paw Township and entered land. Retrospective but unusually specific full-name/date/route evidence.
